atoms.sound: Good morning everyone! Big news: we have a new student joining us today. Would you like to introduce yourself to the class?
Hi... my name is Fatima, and I’m from Pakistan. It’s my first day so I’m a little nervous. But I hope we can be friends!
Hey, I’m Reece. The desk next to me is free, and I can show you around the school too.
Hi Reece, that’s nice of you! Would it be ok if we shared your textbook? I don’t have one yet.
Of course. Just let me know if you need help understanding anything.

atoms.sound: Come on Fatima, I’ll show you around the rest of the school. First, we have the science lab where we do experiments and draw graphs and charts to show the results.
Charts and graphs? Then it’s a good thing I brought my ruler to school! What about this room with all the computers?
This is the computer room, where we mostly work on typing skills and how to do research on the internet. We only have that lesson once a week though.

atoms.sound: Today we are working on our typing skills. Everybody, find a keyboard.
Tomorrow we will be learning how to do research on the internet. Think of a topic you want to learn about.
Please take out your rulers so we can work on our graphs and charts.
Don’t forget to bring your lab coat and safety goggles for tomorrow’s experiment.

Today is my first day of school and I’m so excited! I have all my textbooks for this year and new stationery too. I’m most excited for English. I have Mr Miller this year and I hear he’s a really good teacher.

atoms.a: Which two new things does she have for her first day of school?
b: ++She has all of her new textbooks for this year.
++She has new stationery.
She has a new pair of trainers for PE.

atoms.a: Which lesson is she most excited for?
b: ++She’s most excited for English.
She’s most excited for maths.
She’s most excited for French.

atoms.a: Why is she excited for English?
b: ++She has Mr Miller for English and she hears he’s a good teacher.
Her favourite subject is English.
She wants to be become a better writer and reader.

atoms.sound: Today’s the first day of Year 9 and I’m really nervous. The lessons this year are going to be much harder than last year — especially maths. At least my desk is next to Droov, he’s always helpful when I don’t understand something. I’m going to visit the library to prepare for today’s lesson — it’s next period!

atoms.a: Why is he nervous about his first day of school?
b: ++He’s nervous that the lessons will be much harder this year.
He’s nervous about having a new locker.
He’s nervous that he’s going to miss maths.

atoms.a: Who does he sit next to in maths?
b: ++He sits next to Dhruv.
He sits next to Noor.
He sits next to Mr Miller.

atoms.a: Where is he going before maths and why?
b: ++He is going to the library so he can prepare for the lesson.
He is going to the library so he can borrow a book.
He is going to the sports hall so he can exercise before the lesson.
